title: Hungarian Potatoes
instructions: 1 quart cooked potatoes cut in large pieces

Brown the onion in the fat and add to the potatoes. Add all the ingredients except the parsley; put into a greased casserole and bake forty-five minutes in a moderate oven. Sprinkle with the parsley and serve at once.
